character.description: a shrewd middle-aged female human relic merchant, warm brown skin, dark hair swept into a thick braid over one shoulder, muted burgundy head wrap, teal short traveling coat with ochre lining and many leather pouches, one small brass monocle on a chain, holding a palm-sized dull brass relic in right hand while left rests on leather belt, practical dark trousers and boots, slight knowing smile, no huge backpack

idle.action: gentle breathing and one subtle blink, the relic hand tilts a little and returns, braid sways slightly, both feet planted; sequence relaxed, inhale, exhale with blink, near relaxed. Very small motion, no changing clothing or anatomy.

style: Polished crisp pixel art matching the locked anchor. Preserve face, costume layers, silhouette and all props. Restrained mature proportions, readable at 72 pixels body height. No painterly blur.
